title: Ancestors of Rama
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Discover the glorious lineage and inspiring tales of the ancestors of Lord Rama in this classic Amar Chitra Katha comic.

title: Ayyappan
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The epic story of Lord Ayyappan, his divine birth, brave childhood, and spiritual destiny.

title: Banda Bahadur
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The brave chronicle of Banda Singh Bahadur, the courageous warrior commander of the Sikh Khalsa army.

title: Chandrashekhar Azad
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The fearless journey of revolutionary freedom fighter Chandrashekhar Azad who vowed to stay free forever.

title: Guru Nanak
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The inspiring life and teachings of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, founder of Sikhism and champion of equality.

title: Hothal
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: A riveting folk legend of Gujarat about Hothal Padmini, her valor, and her magical adventure.

title: Manonmani
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Based on the Tamil classic play, the romantic and courageous tale of Princess Manonmani.

title: Monkey Stories - Jataka Tales
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Clever, witty, and humorous Jataka tales featuring wise monkeys outsmarting rivals!

title: Nagananda
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: King Jimutavahana's noble sacrifice to save the Nagas, based on Emperor Harsha's famous Sanskrit play.

title: Pradyumna
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The thrilling quest of Lord Krishna's son Pradyumna and his battles against formidable foes.

title: Purushottam Dev and Padmavati
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The famous Odia folklore of King Purushottam Dev of Puri and his devotion to Lord Jagannath.

title: Raj Singh
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Maharana Raj Singh of Mewar and his heroic stance defending honor and sovereignty.

title: Ram in Exile
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The epic story of Lord Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana during their 14 years in the forest.

title: Ramanuja
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The life of Sri Ramanujacharya, the visionary philosopher who opened temple doors to all.

title: Sakshi Gopal
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The wondrous legend of the Lord standing witness for a young devotee's truth.

title: Sharan Kaur
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The inspiring tale of Sharan Kaur, a heroic Sikh woman who risked her life for honor.

title: Shridutta
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: An adventurous story of wits, romance, and destiny from Kathasaritsagara.

title: Tachcholi Othenan
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The legendary martial arts master and legendary folk hero of North Malabar, Kerala.

title: Tales of Shiva
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Mystical stories of Lord Shiva, Parvati, Ganesha, and the cosmic dance of Mahadeva.

title: Tales of Yudhishthira
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Lessons of truth, righteousness (Dharma), and wisdom from the eldest Pandava brother.

title: Tukaram
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The saint-poet Sant Tukaram of Maharashtra whose Abhangas continue to inspire millions.

title: Valmiki
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: How Ratnakara the dacoit transformed into Maharishi Valmiki, composer of the Ramayana.

title: Veer Dhaval
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: An action-packed folk adventure of bravery, loyalty, and royal intrigue.

title: The Battle of Srinagar
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Major Somnath Sharma and the brave defense of Srinagar airfield in 1947.

title: Sakhi Sarvar
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The popular folk deity of Punjab revered by people of all faiths for his compassion.

title: Tiruppan And Kanakadasa
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The life story of Kanaka Dasa, the warrior-turned-Haridasa saint who challenged social divides through his legendary music and devotion to Lord Krishna.

title: The Deep End
author: Jeff Kinney
description: When the town threatens to close Greg Heffley's crumbling middle school, he must rally his classmates to save it before he gets separated from his best friend, Rowley.

title: The Third Wheel
author: Jeff Kinney
description: A Valentine's Day dance at Greg Heffley's middle school throws his world into chaos. While scrambling to find a date so he isn't left out in the cold, an unexpected twist lands him a partner but leaves his best friend, Rowley, as the ultimate third wheel.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid
author: Jeff Kinney
description: Meet Greg Heffley, a skinny middle-schooler navigating the hazards of cafeteria seating charts, the dreaded Cheese Touch, and his best friend Rowley's embarrassing behavior in his hilarious first journal.

title: Rodrick Rules
author: Jeff Kinney
description: Greg Heffley starts a new school year carrying a humiliating secret. The only problem is his older brother, Rodrick, knows all about it and threatens to expose him to the whole school.

title: The Last Straw
author: Jeff Kinney
description: Frank Heffley thinks he can toughen up his son, so he tries to sign Greg up for sports and threatends to send him to a military academy. Greg must find a way to change his dad's mind before summer begins.

title: Old School)
author: Jeff Kinney
description: Life was better in the old days. Or was it? Greg Heffley finds out when his town voluntarily unplugs from all electronics, forcing him to survive an old-fashioned, technology-free field trip to Hardscrabble Farms.

title: Double Down
author: Jeff Kinney
description: The pressure is piling up on Greg Heffley. His mom thinks video games are turning his brain to mush, so Greg decides to make a scary movie to get her off his back and prove he has big-screen talent.

title: Hot Mess
author: Jeff Kinney
description: Greg Heffley is in for a chaotic summer vacation trapped in a tiny, sweltering beach house with his entire extended family. Amidst the heat and overcrowding, he sets off to uncover the closely guarded family secrets behind Gramma’s famous meatball recipe.
